Question 1
?

Consider the closed curve C, which is the boundary of the region enclosed by y=sin⁡x and the x-axis, for π≤x≤2π. Express ∫Cxdx−(x−y)dy as a repeated integral.

a
−∫π2π∫sin⁡x0dydx
b
∫π2π∫0sin⁡x(x+y)dydx
c
∫π2π∫sin⁡x0xdydx
d
∫π2π∫sin⁡x0(x−y)dydx
e
∫0π∫sin⁡x0dydx
